name: insights
description: What a program did when it ran, and what the editor is doing, with nothing to ask for: every run's statement coverage marked in the gutter of the file it ran (from any debug session that reports it — the tsval debugger does); a profile saved under .silo/profiles/ (the editor saves one when a preview runs slow) announced with where its time went; and a monitor of the metrics plane (memory by realm, workspace fill, long frames, hub traffic, storage) in the status bar and a view of sparkline cards.

silo.machine.markdownDescription: This machine's name in the runtime evidence kept in `.silo/` (each run records where it ran: this name, plus the browser, OS and cores it detects). Name each machine you work on, so timings compare like with like. Empty is `default`.
